title: Correct performance knowledge guidance
summary: Several performance knowledge articles and their samples were corrected for partial records, transactions, N+1 lookups, SIFT, bulk writes and read isolation. The invalid filter-only SetLoadFields rule and the generic production-scale article were removed, and an unsafe Sales Header deletion sample was replaced with a staging-table scenario.
key_points: Corrected the semantics and samples for partial records, transactions, N+1 lookups, SIFT, bulk writes and read isolation
Removed the invalid filter-only fields rule and the generic production-scale article
Narrowed the singleton, TextBuilder, dictionary and temporary-table guidance
Paired good and bad examples now keep the same behaviour
Replaced the unsafe Sales Header deletion sample with a staging-table scenario
quote: correct partial-record, transaction, N+1, SIFT, bulk-write, and read-isolation semantics and samples
